entities.name: Gallia of the Endless Dance
entities.description: An infamous fickle satyr of Theros whose goal is a never-ending party.

entities.name: Gallia of the Endless Dance (Returned)
entities.description: Echoverse version who died by poison, continued partying in the Underworld as a Returned and forgot why she threw parties.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of the dead where the Returned Gallia kept holding banquets.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Gallia dies poisoned at a feast but keeps partying in the Underworld.
events.quote: Gallia died after being poisoned at a feast

events.summary: As a Returned, Gallia throws banquets with no attendants and gradually forgets why.
events.quote: she progressively forgot why she threw parties at all.
